# data/external/

Holds third-party reference geodata that isn't part of the Forest Register
export in `data/raw/` and isn't generated by any script in this repo.

| File | Role | Source | Coverage |
|---|---|---|---|
| `EestiLRjaan2025_kuni_veebr2026/` (shapefile) | National clearcut-polygon layer, used only to identify and exclude clearcut-contaminated training stands (`scripts/clearcut_overlap.py` → `data/reference/clearcut_overlap/stands_overlapping_clearcuts_over20pct.csv`) | Estonian Environment Agency (Keskkonnaagentuur) | Mar 2023 – Feb 2026 |

Not included in this repo (access-controlled / large); place the shapefile
under this directory yourself before running step 4 of the root
`README.md`'s reproduction order (`scripts/clearcut_overlap.py`).
